Although our business activities directly generate a minimal level of GHG emissions and waste, the sale of fossil fuel-based vehicles do emit GHG, which may be subject to a relatively higher policy risk over the next few decades. The Group will keep abreast of these new policies and work closely with business associates to respond to any regulatory changes.
